description: Counted the twenty shillings as spent, and sent the promise out of the kitchen.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Counted fourteen apples, and was sent back to school for the six.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Kept the children, named school for Edmund, and asked for the hall clear.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Forbade a speech at the man's door, and kept the apples moving.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Fed him the heel, and refused the grey as a topic.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Named the wrong wool, and refused to be the legs.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Set Wednesday, and refused Hamnet the errand.
name: William Shakespeare
